title: The level-one coset norm is bounded by the original cusp form near infinity
statement: For every natural number M ≠ 0 and every weight-two cusp form f for Γ₀(M), let H be the image of SL₂(ℤ) in GL₂(ℝ), and let N(f) = ModularForm.norm H f be the existing finite coset norm. There exist real numbers C ≥ 0 and Y such that ‖N(f)(z)‖ ≤ C‖f(z)‖ for every upper-half-plane point z with Y ≤ Im z.
lean_statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), ∃ C Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : UpperHalfPlane, Y ≤ z.im → ‖ModularForm.norm (MonoidHom.range (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ →* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℝ)) f z‖ ≤ C * ‖f z‖
